I need to create a memory called task c4 to explain this puzzle focusing on a 3x3 pattern that expands to a 9x9 grid using reflections. The center remains unchanged while the top and bottom have a vertical reflection of the seed. The left and right reflect horizontally, and the corners undergo a 180-degree rotation. I want to ensure there's no overgeneralization and clearly distinguish between tile tiling and 3x3 tile orientation. I'll include the exact demo and validation results.

    title="Continual-ARC task-c4a32694: expand 3x3 grid by mirrored tiling",

    content="""Accepted recurrence for Continual-ARC task-c4a32694: expand the 3x3 input into a 9x9 grid of nine 3x3 tiles. Keep the original input in the center tile. )
print(mem)
